description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-planning/ (#4708) at a Träger with
two schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger transaction,
its release, the records and their links in one statement each; then per
school the binding of its tenant transaction, the employments with their
profiles, the shifts of the week and the school's own share of the Soll
(workforce.shift_plan_soll, ADR 0242) in one statement each. Flat in the
number of people and shifts.
